rationale: The workflow is already lightweight and includes key optimizations: it uses a job-level concurrency group with cancel-in-progress to supersede runs for the same PR, and an `if` condition that skips execution unless the review is approved by an authorized user and the PR title matches a noteworthy pattern. The job runs in seconds (historical median ~8s), so adding a custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) would yield negligible savings and lacks representative duration history. Path filtering (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER) is not supported for pull_request_review events. Caching, matrix fail-fast, build selection, and other patterns are irrelevant because the workflow has no dependencies, matrix, tests, or build steps. No evidence-supported optimization provides meaningful benefit for this specific workflow.
